409.description: Active identity changed, target is not the immediately previous immutable version, consumer readiness is stale, or another rollback is in flight

503.description: Governed rollback flag, durable publisher, PostgreSQL, or exact consumer readiness is unavailable

get.description: Returns exact broker, ACK-quorum, compensation and active-switch facts for one rollback job. PARTIAL and COMPENSATING never imply that the target is active.

200.description: Tenant-bound rollback receipt

404.description: Rollback receipt absent from this model and tenant

get.description: Authoritative final serving-pointer query. A rollback receipt is final only when state is RECOVERED, active_switched is true, and this endpoint returns target_model_version.

200.description: Current tenant-bound active immutable model version

404.description: No active version exists for this model and tenant

200.description: Tenant-scoped non-archived whitelist entries with approval and rule-effect ACK state

201.description: Draft, immutable version, minimum audit, outbox and durable replay record committed atomically

400.description: Stable action, idempotency, reason, trace, type or value missing

409.description: Duplicate value or idempotency payload collision

post.description: Checks only the authenticated tenant and returns true after the current whitelist version has an applied effective-rule ACK.

200.description: Tenant-scoped effective whitelist match result

400.description: value is required

503.description: Whitelist repository unavailable

200.description: Versioned transition committed; active is not effective until rule_effect_status=applied

403.description: Missing write/approval role, cross-tenant request, or creator attempted own high-risk approval

404.description: Entry absent from authenticated tenant

409.description: Revision, lifecycle, two-person or idempotency conflict

delete.x-compatibility: Existing DELETE route is preserved but now performs a soft archive

200.description: Disabled/draft row soft archived with immutable history, audit and outbox

409.description: Entry must first be disabled or revision/idempotency conflicted

ExpectedRevision.name: If-Match
ExpectedRevision.description: Weak or strong ETag containing the current positive task revision

CampaignSnapshotId.name: snapshot_id
CampaignSnapshotId.description: Content-addressed lifecycle snapshot selected from the campaign list; stale values return 409

tenant_id.description: May only repeat the authenticated tenant; an override is rejected.

end_time.description: Inclusive Unix milliseconds; maximum window is 24 hours

probe_id.description: Compatibility alias for one probe_ids member

alert_id.description: Compatibility alias for one alert_ids member

case_id.description: Compatibility alias for one case_ids member

updated_at.description: Unix milliseconds; zero on the admission-only receipt

download_url.description: Compatibility only; versioned results require purpose-bound presign.

purpose.description: Required for versioned result keys; optional only for the preserved legacy result-key profile.

tenant_id.description: Optional assertion that must match the authenticated tenant; it never overrides authenticated identity

created_at.description: Stable Unix millisecond timestamp included in idempotency identity

from.description: Deprecated compatibility offset; after cursor cutover only the first 1000 results are allowed.

size.description: Cursor modes are further limited to 200.

partial.description: Search timeout and shard failure never return partial data; an independently unavailable PostgreSQL metadata overlay may still be reported explicitly.

command_reason.description: Audit reason for this transition; unlike legacy reason, it never rewrites the FP rationale.

tenant_id.description: Ignored when supplied; tenant identity comes from authentication context.

action_id.description: Optional stable idempotency identity; the server generates one when omitted.
